# `cfr_sections`

**Code of Federal Regulations sections**

One row per GovInfo annual CFR granule, including sections, appendices, tables of contents and other structural units; metadata only, no regulatory body text. Neither a granule id nor a printed section number establishes the enclosing part, so each section granule is placed under the PART heading of its package's annual volume XML: Title 43 numbers sections by subpart (§ 1601.0-1 is in Part 1600), Title 41's parts contain a hyphen (`50-201`) and Title 14 Part 241 prints `19-8.1`. `part` is that structure; `cfr_ref` is the printed citation that joins the Federal Register side. Other granules keep the part their identifier spells, so Title 41's TOC and NODE rows keep parts cut at the hyphen (`50`). The Parquet footer key `spicy_regs.cfr_sections.placement` records that every row was placed by this rule; generations without it keep identifier-derived parts. A package is re-placed only when it is new or its GovInfo lastModified changed; an unchanged package, or one whose volume cannot be read, keeps its prior rows. Missing credentials and incomplete source traversals refuse before output replacement. GovInfo's annual index package (`GPO-CFR-INDEX-2025`) is not a title volume and is not in the table. All columns are stored as VARCHAR.

**Coverage.** Window. Annual-edition metadata from the 2025 and 2026 editions, not full publication history or body text. Measured on the section-ancestry candidate built 2026-09-23 through this builder from the granules of live generation 8fb97150 and the 262 retained annual volumes: 319,501 rows (the six index-package rows dropped); part changed on 9,250 rows (Title 41 4,732, Title 43 3,018, Title 14 volume 4 1,492, eight publisher typos and ranges) with every other column byte-equal. Every compared Title 41, 43 and 14 section agrees with eCFR's 2025-01-01 structure. The candidate is not yet published; until it is, the live generation keeps identifier-derived parts. Receipts: fork-execution-2026-09-21/cfr-ancestry-fix-2026-09-23/ (candidate.json, validation.json). *(measured 2026-09-23)*

- **Parquet file:** `cfr_sections.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `granule_id` | `VARCHAR` | GovInfo granule identifier. Primary key / dedup key, including non-section structural units. |
| `package_id` | `VARCHAR` | GovInfo package identifier for the enclosing annual CFR title and volume. |
| `cfr_ref` | `VARCHAR` | Join key to Federal Register `cfr_references_json`. For a section, the title and its printed citation (e.g. `43-1601.0-1`, `41-50-201.1`); Title 43 keeps its subpart-numbered spelling while `part` names the enclosing part. Title 41's compound-part citations do not join yet: the Federal Register side reads `41 CFR 50-201.1` as `41-50` (plan A7). NULL for ranges, publisher typos, unprefixed numbers (`Sec. 1-1`), parenthesized citations (`1.401(k)-1`), sections outside a numbered PART and section tokens the volume does not hold; 12 single sections printed with `§§` (`§§ 2.188`) are read as ranges until spicy-docs 0.31.0. For other granules, composed from the identifier's tokens (e.g. `48-700`, `15-746.10-app1`); NULL without a part. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | CFR title number from the package or granule identifier (e.g. `40`). |
| `part` | `VARCHAR` | For a section, the number in the enclosing PART heading of the package's annual volume XML (e.g. `1600`, `50-201`, `241`); NULL outside a numbered PART or when the volume does not hold the section. For a section's appendix or TOC (`sec746-10-app1`), its host section's part when the volume holds the host, else its token's leading number. For other granules, the identifier's part token including letter suffixes (e.g. `1203a`), which cuts Title 41's compound parts at the hyphen. |
| `section` | `VARCHAR` | For a section, the printed number less its `{part}.` prefix (e.g. `1` for § 50-201.1, `19-8.1` in Part 241, `1601.0-1` in Part 1600, `401(k)-1`). For a section's appendix or TOC, the rest of its token after the leading number (`10-app1`); for a section token the volume does not hold, the whole token. NULL for other granules. |
| `heading` | `VARCHAR` | Granule heading / caption text from GovInfo's list-level `title` field. |
| `structure_level` | `VARCHAR` | GovInfo granule class / structural level (e.g. `CONTENT`, `NODE`, `TOC`, `APPENDIX`). |
| `edition_year` | `VARCHAR` | Annual edition year from the package or granule identifier, falling back to the year in `dateIssued`. This is not necessarily the printed body revision year or proof of a substantive edition. |
| `last_modified` | `VARCHAR` | Granule `lastModified` when supplied, otherwise the enclosing package's `lastModified`. GovInfo's granule listing supplies none, so in practice every row carries its package's stamp. |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | Canonical GovInfo details URL composed from the package and granule identifiers. |
